sources.summary: Poll data released Tuesday by the New York Times and Siena University confirms what we've already been seeing, and what politicians are responding to - AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular. Asked if they support or oppose the construction of data centers to power AI tech, 61 percent of the 1,503 likely voters surveyed […]
sources.summary_zh: 《紐約時報》與錫耶納大學於週二發布的民調數據，證實了我們早已見到且政治人物正在應對的情況——人工智慧與資料中心極不受歡迎。當被問及是否支持或反對建設資料中心來為 AI 技術提供動力時，受訪的 1,503 名可能選民中有 61% 表示……
